basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Medical Officer: MBBS with compulsory internship, KMC registration and Convocation/Degree certificate. Laboratory Technician: SSLC/PUC and Diploma in Laboratory Technology, Karnataka State Paramedical Board registration and computer literacy. Both need minimum 2 years of service experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Must have passed MBBS and compulsorily completed Internship; should have KMC registration; should have Convocation/Degree certificate from the concerned university. Minimum two years of service experience. Experience required: Minimum two years of service experience. Age limit: Maximum 65 years. Pay: 60000. Qualification required: SSLC/PUC and passed Diploma in Laboratory Technology; compulsorily Karnataka State Paramedical Board registration and computer literacy. Minimum two years of service experience. Experience required: Minimum two years of service experience. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: 12525.

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 60,000 per month (MBBS Medical Officer); Rs. 12,525 per month (Laboratory Technician)

how_to_apply: Appear on 30-11-2026 at 10:00 AM at the Office of the District Health and Family Welfare Officer, K.N.T.B. Sanatorium Hospital premises, Bangarapet Road, Kolar.
Register your name at the interview venue between 10:00 AM and 02:00 PM.
Obtain the application form at the venue between 10:00 AM and 02:00 PM.
Submit the application with marks cards, course completion, caste, computer literacy and experience certificates.
Bring original documents with one set of photocopies.
important_instructions: Only candidates registering at the venue from 10:00 AM to before 02:00 PM on interview day will be interviewed

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DHFWS Kolar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHFWS Kolar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 MBBS Medical Officer, 1 Laboratory Technician.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHFWS Kolar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 30 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - MBBS Medical Officer: maximum 65 years; Laboratory Technician: maximum 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 60000 for MBBS Medical Officer, 12525 for Laboratory Technician.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Medical Officer: MBBS with compulsory internship, KMC registration and Convocation/Degree certificate. Laboratory Technician: SSLC/PUC and Diploma in Laboratory Technology, Karnataka State Paramedical Board registration and computer literacy. Both need minimum 2 years of service experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. MBBS Medical Officer: KMC registration required. Laboratory Technician: Karnataka State Paramedical Board registration compulsory. Laboratory Technician: computer literacy required.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who do not register at the venue between 10:00 AM and 02:00 PM on the interview day will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Selection on roster cum merit basis. Decision of the selection committee is final on any change in the selection process.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment on contract basis for the year 2026-27. Selection subject to NHM rules, terms and conditions.
